_comment: The guard census: the verification surface, recorded so it cannot shrink quietly.
Every entry here exists because a specific regression reached real users.
Deleting one, or emptying it out, re-opens that door -- and line coverage
will not notice, because a guard weakened into a tautology still executes.
RATCHET RULE: the numbers in 'ratchets' may only ever increase. CI fails when
a live value drops below its recorded baseline. Raising a baseline is a normal
commit; LOWERING one is a deliberate, reviewable act that must state why in the
PR description. That is the point -- the goal is not to make weakening
impossible, it is to make it impossible to do SILENTLY.
Adding a new guard: add its path here in the same PR. tests/test_guard_census.py
fails if a file listed here is missing, and the ratchets keep the rest honest.

guard_files.why: IS the merge gate. The single required context aggregates whatever this file lists.
0.12.753 shipped a PEP 604 union at module scope; every CLI subcommand died at import on Python 3.9, including 'clawmetry uninstall'.
Runtime count drifted to 20/14/12 across README, PyPI and FLYWHEEL while the catalogue said something else.
Watchdog for required-check configuration. Its predecessor was unparseable YAML and never ran.
Declares every product x platform x python x runtime cell that must work, so holes cannot open silently.
Measures whether the guards actually catch bugs. Without it, a test weakened into a tautology is invisible -- line coverage cannot see it.
The declared product surface. Deleting it makes every coverage claim unverifiable.
Mutation-score baselines. Removing it silently disables the ratchet.
Proves the matrix checker actually catches drift, rather than rubber-stamping it.
Property tests over the DuckDB store: idempotent ingest, no loss under interleaved flush (issue #1590), clean rejection of torn records.
c6-schedule-heal.yml had two YAML faults and failed at startup on every run for months.
Proves the merge gate actually blocks what it claims to block.
This census. Listed here so removing the enforcement is itself caught.

ossf/scorecard-action@v2 does not exist, so the OpenSSF Scorecard job failed at 'Set up job' on every run since it was written. An unresolvable action never executes a step, so the workflow reads as ran-and-failed rather than never-started.
AC-OBS-CEA-001.2 forbade a $0.00 cost window before #5079 shipped one; the criterion existed and nothing could fail on it. This file is what makes an acceptance criterion failable.

The mirror of the 77 acceptance criteria this repo implements. Emptying it makes the AC gate pass vacuously: zero criteria means zero uncovered, and the ratchet reports success while enforcing nothing.
The AC ratchet itself. Repopulating it with every criterion re-opens every door the gate closed, silently, because the gate would still report OK.
Pins the AC gate's declaration rule. Without it the first draft's loophole returns, where a file naming a criterion it does NOT cover marks that criterion covered.

e2e_gate_required_specs.why: Number of checks aggregated by the merge gate. Was 4 before L0, which let a red CI merge. Adding checks is good; removing them re-opens the hole.

pip_install_matrix_legs.why: 3 OS on 3.11 plus the ubuntu 3.9 leg. Dropping the 3.9 leg is exactly how 0.12.753 escaped.

workflow_files_parsed.why: Workflows under .github/workflows that must parse. Guards against quietly deleting a workflow to make CI green.

declared_matrix_cells.why: Cells declared in verification/matrix.json. Deleting a cell is how you make a coverage problem disappear without fixing it.

gated_matrix_cells.why: Cells whose failure blocks a merge. The number that actually protects main.

mutation_targets.why: Modules under mutation testing. Dropping a target removes the only measurement that can see a weakened assertion.

acceptance_criteria_covered.why: Acceptance criteria (of 77) declared by at least one test. Was 0 across 964 test files. A criterion no test references is prose, not a guard: that is how #5079 shipped a $0.00 cost window that AC-OBS-CEA-001.2 had forbidden for months.
